title: chat: unreadCount computation is implementation-defined
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Chat unreadCount says 'If lastReadMessageId is absent, all messages are counted as unread', so a sender sees their own just-sent message as unread (found in chinwag rehearsal, chinwag bead chinwag-dxgx.25). Mark decided 2026-10-30: the draft should say which messages count toward unreadCount is implementation-defined (servers MAY, e.g., exclude the owner's own messages). chinwag/crate-jmap will exclude the owner's own messages. Same consideration for unreadReplyCount.
